reviews.t: Like going from commercial grade to professional grade!
reviews.x: I'm just a dude who engages in nail maintenance every month or so.  I was doing so one night, and thought later about it why I don't do it more often.  I was fine with the clipper part, (I use an inexpensive pair for that) , but it was the filing that was tedious.  The file would slip, and was uncomfortable on the flesh below the fingernail.  Then I ordered this!  First off, it's wide, and doesn't slip. It's also the perfect grit, filing off just the right amount. The sheer comfort of the thing,

Did some research on long lasting nail files before buying this one. Wanted to make sure I was buying quality. I'm glad I did. Works very well, sturdy, washable, ok cover/sleeve but decent. 2 sided makes it better too. Has smooth handle that is same width and height as file. It's all one smooth piece of glass. There's a little mirror on it that I haven't really used yet. File is at least twice as thick as an Emory board and stiff, obviously. I use it on natural finger nails and it's perfect.

reviews.t: This particular brand of glass nail file works!!!
reviews.x: If you're looking for a glass nail file, get this one! I never write reviews but I feel that this product deserves a 5-star rating and review. My sister has been telling me how awesome glass nail files are for years, but after getting one locally at Walgreens and thinking how terrible and ineffective that one was, I was hesitant to buy into the hype. This doesn't scratch your skin or get in the way of precise filing due to its size. The grit is perfect and it's washable. I was finally able to ac

reviews.t: Works well, but very fragile: I snapped it in half within a week
reviews.x: Snapped in half within a week: after running it under water in the sink, I grabbed it with a towel with one hand, planning on pulling it out of the towel with the other hand to dry it, but to my surprise it snapped in two when I gripped it through the towel. I've had other 'glass nail files' in the past, typically acquired from booths at town fairs, and they seem extremely durable when compared to this product. Maybe the one I received had a defect compromising the structural integrity, but I ha

reviews.t: When they say "GLASS" they mean it!
reviews.x: They work so well, but they are GLASS!!!!! they break at any possible opportunity! If you're extremely careful with them, you'll truly enjoy them. But when they say "Glass" they truly mean it. After the second purchase and breaking, that was it for me.
Just received this today and it snapped in half the first time I used it! I realize it is made of glass, but I was not putting much pressure on it at all. I can not recommend this product.
Great nail file! However, it broke within a week! I kept it in its container, yet it still split. It would be 5 stars if it didn't break...

I really loved the very first glass nail file I bought but it broke into two pieces when it fell on the floor. So I have been looking for another good one ever since. And I believe I have found it. The glass on this file is thick and durable. I like how quickly I am able to file my nail down and shape them. The file is not smooth it does have a little bit of a rough texture but I think that contributes to the overall quality of how this file performs. I have natural nails and it works great for

reviews.t: Great file at a great price.
reviews.x: I was looking for a file to replace my Sephora crystal glass file and came across this. In comparison this file is lighter, thinner and smaller. I will say that despite that the file works great for my natural nails. I'm a bit heavy handed so I wish it had more weight to it. If you are gentle enough to handle a thinner file without snapping it go for it. All in all a great file at a great price.

This is so thick I’m not sure what kind of nails this is for. An elephant maybe? There’s no way to get the edges of your nails without getting skin in it. I returned it after trying it a couple times and injuring my side cuticles.

It's been a great nail file thus far. It seems gentler than the metal files I've used in the past but I miss having the fine-point pick of the metal files. You cannot pick under your nails with this, just file them.

This is the WORST nail file ever. Dulls really easy and is too thick. I purchased because I heard crystal files help your nails from splitting. I saw the same ones at Bed Bath&Beyond for 3.00. I was so pissed.

reviews.t: Broke within a couple of uses
reviews.x: Product broke with normal use within weeks. For the price I wouldn't be too concerned.

reviews.t: Blah results. I didn't see/feel any difference.

I bought this because I saw it was recommended for use with jamberries. I have some but I was interested in using it with my super thin sensationail nail shields. reviews.x: Awesome. I fell in love with glass nail files when I got my first one over ten years ago at a farmers market and haven't looked back since. I got this one to replace my first one since I accidentally seem to have misplaced it. I love that you can use these in a back and forth motion without worrying about ruining  your nails or making them jagged. I use this file to file my nails down completely, I rarely need to cut them. These files last forever and are super easy to clean. Would definitely re

Not really a connoisseur on nail files but going from using 120 grit sandpaper to this thing is really night and day. Those trusty old boards with the sand of death on them are a thing of the past now. It's amazing the amount of first world problems this fixes. No more catching a rough nail on a piece of clothing and almost ripping the nail off. No more scratching an itch and creating a gash that looks like I got mauled by a rabid cat. It does what it says and does it really well. Just buy one a

File feels and works well- has a larger grain side and a smaller grain size. The only drawback is that the tip of the file is not thin enough to dig out everything from under a nail, it's simply too thick. It gets most of the nail, but definitely doesn't reach the edges. I was looking for a crystal file because I go through the disposable cardboard ones too fast and metal is too harsh on my thin brittle nails. This crystal file has a beautiful design, a fine and extra fine grit one either side. It comes in a little pouch that keeps it protected. The owners of the company are very nice and provided great customer service via email. It's a beautiful, great working product that is very well priced for how long I'll plan on using it for (fingers crossed it doesn't b

reviews.t: I am thrilled with this purchase!
reviews.x: I have very soft, problematic nails due to thyroid issues, and some emery boards leave jagged surfaces that can cause my nails to split and peel.  I have tried every "fine" and "extra-fine" nail file I can find, and the result is always the same, until now.  This is my first time using a crystal nail file, and the result is outstanding!  Not a single rough edge that might snag on something.  I'm so glad I decided to buy two so I can keep one in my purse.

This nail file arrived quickly and works beautifully. I got it for a friend of mine since she loved mine that I have had for years. It came well wrapped in its own sleeve, bubble wrap, and custom box. The file is double sided with a nice grit for shaping and filing nails without leaving marks. One side of the top of the nail file had a mirror on it. I did not see this in the offered product but it is nice. I will be getting more in the future for presents.

reviews.t: Outclasses an emery board in every way
reviews.x: Wow, way better quality than an emery board. I also like that I won't have to replace this, or at least as frequently as a standard file. It's always nice to spend a relatively small amount for something of high quality that doesn't take up space and will last. My nails look great, and the file is beautiful too. This makes a great gift idea, and I'll be sure to get the women in my life some of these as their birthdays and holidays approach.

reviews.t: I do like that the nail edges are as smooth as glass ...
reviews.x: I  have never worked with a file that wasn't metal or an emery board before, so this glass file is a new experience.  I do like that the nail edges are as smooth as glass (ha ha) and don't snag.  It is heavier than I am used to and thicker, so filing a short nail near the finger tip is taking some learning.  Overall, this is a lovely product and I like the idea of using a glass file.  Thank you for making it available.

I have been struggling with terrible nails for as long as I can remember. They will never grow out much past my fingertips and the second they did they would break.. I was never one to be able to see a white tip for very long. I have not used any other product except for this nail file and I have not had a broken nail since I started using it. It's sorcery..

reviews.t: I bought this to see if my sensitive nails liked it better than store bought nail files and I'm ...
reviews.x: I bought this to see if my sensitive nails liked it better than store bought nail files and I'm most pleased. I do like that I can file either direction and there does not seem to be the typical damage that comes with it. Between this and my new non-toxic nail polish remover, my nails are happier than ever. Will be investing in more when this one wears out!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the file works very well and effectively shapes nails.
A common complaint is that the file is fragile and snaps or breaks easily, sometimes within a week or on first use.
Several reviewers describe the file as too thick, making it hard to use around the edges and cuticles.
Some reviewers praise the file as durable and sturdy.
A few reviewers note the file dulls easily or produces no noticeable difference.
